title: Phase 66 EXP-01 main run (plan 66-04): exp01-d1-w384-o1000 on system 1632, seed 42, MPS float32, 465000 steps
committed_before: the first run of this registered experiment role; the settings, the cap, the cadence and the reading rule are immutable after the run

settings.orbit_note: Stage-0 training gold record of system 1632, split train, manifest stage 0; the only record the guarded seam may open

loss.definition: INST-05 data_huber_loss over the windowed gold targets

settings.timing_definitions: synchronized completed-work segments: admission and data load recorded by the CLI; setup (model and optimizer build), the 200 warmup updates, the 464800 measured updates, similarity logging, frozen scoring and publication recorded separately by the fit; every segment wrapped in the MPS _synchronize helper with an injected monotonic clock; seconds_per_step is the measured 464800-update sum over 464800, excluding warmup, logging and scoring; end-to-end seconds per completed step is total wall over 465000

reading_rule.mechanical_pass: all 465000 finite updates, exactly the fourteen registered similarity entries at steps 0/100/300/1000/3000/10000/30000/100000/160833/221666/282500/343333/404166/465000, the frozen network score and both comparison rows on the same window, Stage-0 TRAIN-only access evidence, all within the 3300-second cap; no E/tier threshold and no expected improvement is imposed
reading_rule.incomplete: an interrupted, over-cap or non-finite attempt records status incomplete with its reason and publishes nothing; it is never retried, extended or resumed and never substitutes for a record
reading_rule.out_of_branch: any outcome this rule does not describe is reported to the orchestrator rather than interpreted; a run with a mechanical problem reads out-of-branch and goes to the owner, and a branch is never read from a run that did not test the registered network on the registered orbit under the gate
reading_rule.branch_rule: classify_exp01 with NEAR_BAND 0.05 against the record's own constant-predictor E (comparisons[window_mean_constant].score.E) and still_improving from improvement_check with IMPROVEMENT_RULE (the DIAG-09 output movement, reference at or before 0.75 of the final step, strict 0.01 growth); tier1 is the scorecard's Tier-1 E_max 0.1 inclusive; labels tier1/near/between/other/unsettled; confirmed only when all three runs share tier1 or near

logger_parity.note: D-10: the real-arm logger-parity receipt from the registered probe run precedes this smoke; admission verifies the receipt is a successful measurement whose bytes match the recorded run commit

context.note: the historical lead's registered branch (144/144 required fields reproduced) is recorded but never required for the independent fit mechanics; the smoke does not rescue, refute or re-interpret it
